name: What technology is typically used to create a virtual home tour?

mainEntity.name: What technology is typically used to create a virtual home tour?

acceptedAnswer.text: Virtual home tours are primarily created using specialized 3D cameras and software platforms like Matterport, which capture comprehensive spatial data. These tools stitch together panoramic images to create a navigable, interactive model of the property. Other methods might include high-resolution 360-degree cameras or drone footage for exterior views. Understanding the technology helps explain the process clarity, showing how detailed and immersive experiences are generated to give buyers a realistic sense of a home's environment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Virtual home tours are primarily created using specialized 3D cameras and software like Matterport, which generate interactive, navigable property models.
